user.title: BlockFront Official API
user.description: Public data works without a key. Enter your UUID to preserve a stable player identity. Only official keys are accepted.

error.invalid_username: Zadaj platné Minecraft meno (3 až 16 písmen, číslic alebo podčiarkovníkov).
error.invalid_api_url: Zadaj platnú HTTP alebo HTTPS adresu API bez prihlasovacích údajov, parametrov a fragmentu.
error.cannot_connect: K službe so štatistikami BlockFront sa nepodarilo pripojiť. Skús to neskôr.

abort.already_configured: Tento hráč BlockFront je už pridaný.

init.title: Official API: access and data
init.description: An empty key field keeps the saved key. Use Remove saved API key to return to public-only mode. Private entity identities and recorded history are preserved. Data selection also controls endpoint polling. Map and brigade/match detail metrics are optional.
